---
title: "Diversity Results"
---

```{r}
#| include: false
setup_file <- if (file.exists("_report_setup.R")) "_report_setup.R" else file.path("report", "code", "_report_setup.R")
source(setup_file)
alpha <- read_if_exists(file.path(plan$paths$results_dir, "alpha_diversity.tsv"))
alpha_results <- read_if_exists(file.path(plan$paths$results_dir, "alpha_diversity_results.tsv"))
diversity_status <- read_if_exists(file.path(plan$paths$results_dir, "diversity_model_status.tsv"))
ordination <- read_if_exists(file.path(plan$paths$results_dir, "ordination_coordinates.tsv"))
permanova_files <- list.files(project_file(plan$paths$results_dir), pattern = "_permanova[.]tsv$", full.names = TRUE)
```

## Alpha Diversity Values

```{r}
table_out(alpha, "Alpha diversity by sample", n = 50)
```

## Alpha Diversity Models

```{r}
table_out(alpha_results, "Alpha diversity model and rank-test results", n = 100)
```

## Beta Diversity Ordination

```{r}
table_out(ordination, "PCoA coordinates", n = 50)
```

## PERMANOVA

```{r}
if (!length(permanova_files)) {
  table_out(data.frame(note = "No PERMANOVA table found", stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
} else {
  for (path in permanova_files) {
    cat("###", basename(path), "\n\n")
    print(table_out(read_if_exists(path), n = 20))
    cat("\n")
  }
}
```

## Model Status

```{r}
table_out(diversity_status, "Diversity model status", n = 100)
```
